mostWorthwhile.text: Heating the aggregate and cooling the droplets into chondrules was worthwhile: their textures preserve evidence of rapid heating and cooling.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial attempt to put rocky dust in hot inner orbits was frustrating because the material had no available operation despite fitting the apparent goal.

surprise.text: Inherited grains can evaporate in the hot inner disk and later condense as refractory minerals, rather than simply surviving unchanged.

arbitrary.text: The failed pairings that automatically selected different partners felt somewhat arbitrary, particularly when the inner disk required the Sun before hot orbits could be used.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the ice store and rocky mixture become larger bodies, especially after learning that having the ingredients together is not yet planet formation.
